abstract.text: We argue that BPS ansatzes, entering manifestly vacuum BPS monopole solutions to equations of motion in the (Minkowskian) non-Abelian Higgs model play the role of some electric form-factors and that this implies (soft) violating the CP-invariance of the mentioned model, similar to taking place in the Euclidian Yang-Mills (YM) theory with instantons, generating the θ-term in the appropriate effective Hamiltonian.

thesis.text: In the Minkowskian non-Abelian Higgs model with vacuum BPS monopole solutions, the BPS ansatzes f0BPS and f1BPS act as electric form-factors, and their presence softly violates CP invariance, analogously to instanton θ-term effects but without an explicit θ-dependence.

abstract.text: We argue that BPS ansatzes, entering manifestly vacuum BPS monopole solutions to equations of motion in the (Minkowskian) non-Abelian Higgs model play the role of some electric form-factors and that this implies (soft) violating the CP-invariance of the mentioned model, similar to taking place in the Euclidian Yang-Mills (YM) theory with instantons, generating the θ-term in the appropriate effective Hamiltonian.
